headline: Anthropic's biotech acquisition signals healthcare AI infrastructure shift
body: Anthropic acquired a single-person biotech lab amid broader momentum including new mathematical proofs and IPO discussions, marking the company's expansion into domain-specific applications. For healthcare AI, this move suggests major vendors are building specialized capabilities beyond general-purpose models to address clinical validation and regulatory requirements. The acquisition pattern indicates a vendor strategy shift toward acquiring niche expertise rather than building internally, which will reshape how healthcare organizations evaluate AI partnerships and integration costs with their EHR systems and clinical workflows.
